# mcp-vault

> Local-first MCP secret vault (Merkle). Specs under docs/arch are the
> architectural source of truth; doc/arch hosts the speckit control plane with
> symlinks into that corpus. Code implements the spec.

## Documentation

- [Agent context](AGENTS.md): dense LLM project map
- [Grok guide](GROK.md): Grok Build notes
- [Human overview](README.md): product and security story
- [Architecture corpus](docs/arch/): ADRs, domain, OpenAPI, Gherkin, CUE
- [Speckit plane](doc/arch/): constitution, governance, SDD, symlinks
- [Companion Socket OpenAPI](docs/arch/integrations/openapi/companion-socket.yaml)
- [Threat model](docs/arch/threat-model/stride-analysis.md)
- [Privacy (LINDDUN)](doc/arch/threat-model/privacy-threat-model.md)

## Protocol

spec-first: read docs/arch (or doc/arch symlinks) before writing code. Drive
speckit with `~/bin/speckit` only. Behavioral changes update the corpus in the
same change train as implementation.
